profiles.name: Eth_N_Chel2_SmoothV3_AntiCrash
profiles.description:
Smoothed v3 AntiCrash — conservative 50 g version. Same roast-temperature curve and PID as v2; fan adjusted for stronger early bean movement and a flatter first-crack transition to reduce airflow-induced RoR crash/flick risk.
Targets:
- Start: 30°C
- CC: 3:49 @ 155°C
- FC: 7:15 @ 204°C
- Drop: 8:00 @ 209°C
- RoR decline interval: 3:30–7:00
- Use only after Fan Preview confirms continuous bean circulation.
